name: How long does a typical combined roofing and exterior painting project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical combined roofing and exterior painting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a combined roofing and exterior painting project varies based on the scope of work, weather conditions, and the size of your property. Generally, a residential roof replacement can take 1-3 days, while exterior painting might require 3-7 days, including prep and drying times. When coordinated, these projects typically span 1 to 2 weeks, allowing for sequential completion and proper curing between stages. We provide an estimated timeline during the initial consultation and keep you updated on progress, accounting for potential weather delays in the DFW region.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical combined roofing and exterior painting project can take 1-2 weeks, depending on the property size, scope of work, and weather conditions in the DFW area.
